<thought>Since specifying functional groups returned no templates, broaden the search to only the bond changes: break a C‑C single bond (6-6) and form a C‑O single bond (6-8). This should retrieve any cycloaddition-like retrosynthetic templates applicable to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "bonds_broken": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
